# Productivity / Excel

Write error-free Excel formulas, use modern LAMBDA and dynamic-array functions, and organise, format and inspect workbooks.

| Skill | What it does | Scripts |
|-------|--------------|---------|
| [excel-advanced-formulas](excel-advanced-formulas/SKILL.md) | Modern Excel 365/2021+ formulas — LAMBDA and LAMBDA helpers (MAP, REDUCE, SCAN, BYROW, BYCOL), LET, dynamic arrays (FILTER, SORT, UNIQUE, HSTACK, VSTACK, TAKE, DROP), TEXTSPLIT, REGEX functions, GROUPBY and PIVOTBY. | `check_compat.py` |
| [excel-formulas](excel-formulas/SKILL.md) | Write error-free Excel formulas — syntax rules, cell references, math, logical, lookup (VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, XLOOKUP), text, date/time and conditional aggregation (SUMIFS, COUNTIFS) with error handling. | `check_formula.py` |
| [excel-fundamentals](excel-fundamentals/SKILL.md) | Excel workbook fundamentals — cells, ranges, absolute/relative references, named ranges, number formats, conditional formatting, sheets and views, sorting, filtering, tables and keyboard shortcuts. | `inspect_workbook.py` |
